entries.en: Added a "Dynamic workflow size" setting in `/config` for controlling how large Claude generally makes dynamic workflows (small/medium/large agent counts) — an advisory guideline, not an enforced cap
entries.zh: 在`/config`中添加了“动态工作流程大小”设置，用于控制克劳德通常创建的动态工作流程的大小（小/中/大代理计数）——建议指南，而不是强制上限

entries.en: Added `workflow.run_id` and `workflow.name` OpenTelemetry attributes to telemetry emitted by workflow-spawned agents, so a workflow run's activity can be reconstructed from OTel data
entries.zh: 向工作流生成的代理发出的遥测添加了`workflow.run_id`和`workflow.name` OpenTelemetry 属性，以便可以从 OTel 数据重建工作流运行的活动

entries.en: Improved `/workflows` agent list layout: wider titles, a dedicated time column, shorter model names, and no per-row tool-call counts
entries.zh: 改进 `/workflows` 代理列表布局：标题更宽，新增专门的时间列，模型名称更短，不再显示每行的工具调用次数

entries.en: Improved MCP error messages: clearer error when a server config has `url` but no `type`, suggesting `"type": "http"` instead of the misleading "command: expected string"
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 错误提示：配置中有 `url` 但没有 `type` 时，会给出更清楚的报错，并建议使用 `"type": "http"`，不再误导性地提示“command: expected string”

entries.en: Changed `/review <pr>` back to a fast single-pass review; use `/code-review <level> <pr#>` for the multi-agent review at a chosen effort level
entries.zh: 将 `/review <pr>` 更改回快速单遍审核；使用`/code-review <level> <pr#>`在选定的工作级别进行多代理审核

entries.en: Fixed a crash in the inline Ctrl+R history search when accepting or cancelling while the search was still scanning the history file
entries.zh: 修复了当搜索仍在扫描历史文件时接受或取消时内联 Ctrl+R 历史搜索中的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` on background sessions being reverted when the job restarts, which broke addressing the session by its new name
entries.zh: 修复了作业重新启动时后台会话上的`/rename`，这会破坏通过新名称对会话进行寻址

entries.en: Fixed transient mTLS handshake failures when settings were re-applied during an in-place client certificate rotation
entries.zh: 修复设置在原地更换客户端证书时被重新应用，导致临时 mTLS 握手失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed commands sent from Remote Control (mobile/web) into an interactive session failing with "Unknown command"
entries.zh: 修复了从远程控制（移动/网络）发送到交互式会话的命令失败并显示“未知命令”的问题

entries.en: Fixed images and files sent from the Remote Control mobile or web app without a caption being silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了从远程控制移动或网络应用程序发送的图像和文件，且标题没有被静默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed the sign-in URL printed by `claude auth login` and `claude mcp login --no-browser` not being reliably clickable when it wraps over SSH — it is now emitted as a single hyperlink
entries.zh: 修复 `claude auth login` 和 `claude mcp login --no-browser` 打印的登录链接在 SSH 中换行后无法稳定点击的问题；现在它会作为一个完整超链接输出

entries.en: Fixed opening a chat from `claude agents` sometimes failing with "currently running as a background agent" followed by a worker crash/respawn loop
entries.zh: 修复了从“克劳德代理”打开聊天有时会失败并显示“当前作为后台代理运行”，然后出现工作人员崩溃/重生循环的问题

entries.en: Fixed workflow scripts with unicode quote escapes in strings being corrupted before parsing; workflow parse errors now show the offending line instead of always blaming TypeScript
entries.zh: 修复字符串中含有 Unicode 引号转义的工作流脚本在解析前被损坏的问题；工作流解析错误现在会显示出错行，而不是总是归咎于 TypeScript

entries.en: Fixed voice dictation retrying in an unbounded loop when the microphone or audio recorder fails — repeated capture failures now pause voice input
entries.zh: 修复麦克风或录音器失败时，语音听写会无限循环重试的问题；现在反复的录音失败会暂停语音输入

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` sessions showing the wrong permission mode in the mobile and web apps
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`会话在移动和网络应用程序中显示错误的权限模式

entries.en: Fixed resuming a session by name, or opening the resume picker, taking minutes and using a large amount of memory in repositories with many git worktrees
entries.zh: 修复了按名称恢复会话或打开简历选择器、需要几分钟时间并在具有许多 git 工作树的存储库中使用大量内存的问题

entries.en: Fixed installer and updater downloads failing immediately with "aborted" when a proxy or network drops the connection mid-download — transient connection drops now retry
entries.zh: 修复了当代理或网络在下载过程中断开连接时，安装程序和更新程序下载立即失败并“中止”的问题 - 暂时连接断开现在重试

entries.en: Fixed re-invoking an already-loaded skill appending a duplicate copy of its instructions to context
entries.zh: 修复了重新调用已加载的技能并将其指令的重复副本附加到上下文的问题
